phases.title: Allocation Truth Boundary
acceptance: candidate allocation, preview candidate, committed receipt, and durable semantic state are distinct runtime categories with anti-bypass type fences
host paint and runtime APIs cannot coerce preview candidate truth into committed receipt truth
receipt commitment remains downstream of admitted planning and upstream of host receipt consumption
phases.instructions: Implement 3.8 Phase 1. Freeze the allocation ontology as real type and authority boundaries so later churn work cannot hide in report mutation, host paint, or gesture helpers.
phases.qa_focus: No candidate-to-committed coercion, no preview truth laundering through freshness posture, and no host-owned geometry lane.

phases.title: Allocation Receipt Identity, Generation, And Reuse Contract
acceptance: UiAllocationReceipt is scoped per admitted neighborhood while ordered neighborhood-set work lives in a separate transaction artifact
receipt identity, generation, equivalence basis, reuse verdict, and denial posture are explicit and inspectable
structure_reuse_leaf_remeasure is the only admitted partial-reuse posture in 3.8
phases.instructions: Implement 3.8 Phase 2. Close receipt identity, per-neighborhood commit semantics, reuse law, and report lineage so later phases cannot invent helper-owned granularity or digest folklore.
phases.qa_focus: No neighborhood-or-set ambiguity, no undefined equivalence identity, and no denial path that silently mutates committed truth in place.

phases.title: Stream Classification And Commit-Cadence Contract
acceptance: stream families classify through one runtime-owned policy table with total same-frame merge law
cadence budgets, evidence cadence, and override admissibility live on admitted policy families
same-frame multi-stream pressure resolves through typed merge or typed denial rather than ad hoc priority hacks
phases.instructions: Implement 3.8 Phase 3. Freeze stream policy as a runtime law surface with explicit merge ordering, numeric budgets, and evidence cadence rather than generic debounce behavior.
phases.qa_focus: No per-feature policy code, no partial merge table, and no raw-ingress evidence explosion masquerading as observability.

phases.title: Typed Invalidation Intake And Family Closure
acceptance: allocation invalidation families are closed, typed, and anti-bypass fenced before incremental replan lands
Query-backed layout facts enter only through admitted projection-consumption settlement and mapping law
host observations can target existing runtime neighborhoods and receipts but cannot mint new semantic dependency lanes
phases.instructions: Implement 3.8 Phase 4. Close invalidation intake as a first-class runtime boundary that consumes graph and Query truth rather than re-deriving dependency meaning locally.
phases.qa_focus: No generic something-changed bucket, no host-owned dependency edges, and no local Query payload cache becoming allocation authority.

phases.title: Affected-Neighborhood Replan Selection
acceptance: replan work is expressed as an ordered transaction set over admitted neighborhoods with deterministic ordering and widen reasons
root primary, counted root widen, and forbidden root fallback are mechanically distinct
locality proof consumes authority-graph indexes, touched-graph consequences, and admitted replacement impact rather than recursive scans
phases.instructions: Implement 3.8 Phase 5. Turn locality into a transaction-shaped proof artifact so later resize, scroll, and portal churn cannot collapse into hidden broad replans.
phases.qa_focus: No root fallback disguised as shell work, no helper-owned dependency maps, and no set-order folklore that only exists in replay logs.

phases.title: Continuous Viewport Resize Semantics
phases.owner: worth-ui viewport invalidation and cadence authority
acceptance: viewport extent observations classify through a distinct invalidation family and policy lane
viewport churn stays neighborhood-bounded with explicit receipt-count ceilings per policy
viewport observations cannot author durable semantic-state mutation or graph ownership
phases.instructions: Implement 3.8 Phase 6. Close viewport resize as host extent observation plus derived invalidation and commit policy, not as a hidden sibling of drag-driven resize state.
phases.qa_focus: No splitter-policy inheritance, no silent root collapse under shell churn, and no host observation becoming durable runtime meaning.

phases.title: Drag Preview And Durable Resize Commit
phases.owner: worth-ui drag preview and durable resize authority
acceptance: preview candidate paint and durable resize mutation are distinct lanes with separate cadences and explicit policy law
pointer-rate preview does not mutate committed receipt truth or durable semantic state unless admitted policy says so
durable resize mutation counts and committed receipt counts are bounded and inspectable
phases.instructions: Implement 3.8 Phase 7. Close drag preview and durable resize as separate runtime acts so continuous interaction never becomes implicit layout authority.
phases.qa_focus: No preview-through-report mutation, no gesture-local durable-state writes, and no hidden side effects during preview rendering.

phases.title: Scroll-Owned Allocation Semantics
acceptance: scroll-owned extent changes invalidate allocation through runtime-owned family semantics while pure offset remains projected interaction only
unsupported or contradictory scroll ownership denies with typed evidence rather than host fallback
3.8 does not smuggle virtualization or offset-sensitive allocation into ordinary scroll semantics
phases.instructions: Implement 3.8 Phase 8. Keep scroll ownership narrow, explicit, and runtime-owned, and freeze the non-virtualized default rather than leaving offset semantics mushy.
phases.qa_focus: No host-owned scroll dependency lane, no hidden virtualization assumptions, and no offset-triggered invalidation unless explicitly admitted.

phases.title: Portal-Anchored Allocation Semantics
acceptance: portal anchor identity, coordinate-space posture, and invalidation rules are explicit and typed
equivalent anchor rect movement preserves or replaces identity only according to the frozen portal identity rule
portal anchor churn widens only through graph-owned locality proof and typed transaction evidence
phases.instructions: Implement 3.8 Phase 9. Close portal anchoring as an allocation lane with explicit identity and locality law rather than floating host glue.
phases.qa_focus: No host-owned portal membership graph, no phantom anchor identity rule, and no layer-spanning bypass of neighborhood proof.

phases.title: Allocation Inspection Surface
acceptance: ordinary inspection can explain receipt existence, invalidation family, locality choice, reuse or denial, and geometry evidence without causal escalation
allocation inspection returns exact evidence refs and geometry-floor schema required by the spec
AI critique-readiness consumes receipt-backed geometry truth rather than screenshots or logs as primary authority
phases.instructions: Implement 3.8 Phase 10. Extend the shared inspection substrate so allocation truth is inspectable and critique-ready without minting a second debugger runtime.
phases.qa_focus: No logs-as-evidence, no causal-inspection dependency for local why, and no screenshot archaeology replacing receipt-backed geometry.

phases.title: Allocation Freshness And Lag Posture
acceptance: freshness and lag postures live on append-only receipt-report lineage rather than silent mutation of committed truth
posture transitions are explicit, typed, and consumer-legality constrained
host paint and later execution consumers obey different admitted freshness-consumption rules where the appendix says so
phases.instructions: Implement 3.8 Phase 11. Close freshness as a real state-transition contract over report lineage instead of a bag of adjectives attached after the fact.
phases.qa_focus: No committed-equals-current folklore, no denied-without-artifact home, and no preview sneaking back in as a committed-report posture.

phases.title: Allocation Counters And Denial Taxonomy
phases.owner: worth-ui allocation boundedness and denial authority
acceptance: counter names, denial families, and evidence cadence are explicit runtime surfaces rather than test-only commentary
mandatory denial families and widen reasons are closed and inspectable
boundedness proof can assert concrete maxima for receipt count, durable mutation count, neighborhood-set cardinality, and root-widen behavior
phases.instructions: Implement 3.8 Phase 12. Freeze the counters and denial vocabulary as production authority so performance and failure shape stay mechanically auditable.
phases.qa_focus: No generic fallback denials, no counter logic hiding only in certification, and no unbounded evidence churn at ingress rate.

phases.title: Runtime Integration And Certification Closeout
acceptance: the full hostile scenario runs through admitted graph, Query, measurement, invalidation, transaction, receipt, inspection, and certification lanes without bypass
deterministic replay, anti-bypass fences, and concrete oracle ceilings are proven on the real ordinary lane
3.9 can consume committed allocation truth without reopening preview semantics, receipt granularity, locality proof, freshness law, or denial vocabulary
phases.instructions: Implement 3.8 Phase 13. Close the milestone by proving the hostile ordinary lane, not by leaning on test-only shortcuts or certification-owned semantics.
phases.qa_focus: No production behavior hiding behind fixture seams, no remaining parallel dependency graph, and no closeout that still leaves 3.9 to answer 3.8's law questions.
